verdict.rationale: Convex documents that every public request can be checked against authorization rules you define in code inside server functions. It explicitly says it doesn't need an opinionated RLS framework like Firebase or Supabase, and instead lets you build your own authorization layer. Per-user access restriction is therefore the documented model, but it has to be hand-written in function code rather than expressed as declarative row-level policies or security rules. Missing for 10: a declarative RLS or security-rules engine, documented per-user/row-level policy examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
